_meta.notes: Every string the interface says in its own voice, in one file so the copy budget can be linted. Templates use {braces}. Keep each under its cap in engine/copy-budget.js.

chrome.firstRun: Nothing here can be closed to you.
chrome.subjectsHint: Tap a level. Tap again to undo.
chrome.perfHead: What it asks for at the end
chrome.perfNote: This app does not know your grades and never guesses them.
chrome.askHead: Take one question to a person
chrome.levelsMove: Levels move. Students change them every year.
chrome.shareHint: Copy the link. It holds your plan and nothing else.
chrome.footer: A thinking tool, not official advice. Check with your ECG counsellor.
chrome.stale: Last checked {days} days ago. Criteria change.

pulse.removed: {subject} off the list. {dest} still has a road in.
pulse.noChange: {subject} at {level}. Nothing shifted, and that is normal.
pulse.allOpen: All eight open. Which two years do you actually want?
pulse.rest: Two are open before you pick anything.

load.heavy: That is a heavy load. Four done well beats seven done thinly, at every admission point.
load.solid: A normal load. Is there one in there you took for the look of it?
load.spread: A balanced spread. Depth usually serves people better than a thin layer.
load.early: Still early. Check you have not ruled out something you never tried.

ask.move: Ask your {who}: what would it take to move my {subject} up?
ask.dest: Ask your ECG counsellor: what is {dest} actually like day to day?
ask.aim: Ask an adult who does this: what are the bad days like?
ask.open: Ask your form teacher: which of these would suit how I learn?
